text:
Some electric hotplates are metal and do not glow when hot.
Other hotplates are glass and have a heater underneath that glows red. The heater makes the
glass hot.
With both hotplates, there is no air gap between the hotplate and a metal pan placed on the
hotplate.
Which statement is correct?
A
The glass hotplate transfers less energy by radiation to the base of the pan than the metal
hotplate.
B
The glass hotplate transfers energy by convection to the base of the pan.
C
The metal hotplate transfers energy by conduction to the base of the pan.
D
The metal hotplate transfers energy by convection to the base of the pan.

options.label: A
options.text: The glass hotplate transfers less energy by radiation to the base of the pan than the metal

options.label: B
options.text: The glass hotplate transfers energy by convection to the base of the pan.

options.label: C
options.text: The metal hotplate transfers energy by conduction to the base of the pan.

options.label: D
options.text: The metal hotplate transfers energy by convection to the base of the pan.
